This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 8-4. TRICYCLE GEAR AIRCRAFT".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a close-up of a tricycle landing gear door linkage installation on an aircraft wing or fuselage fairing, with a hinged access panel, a push-pull rod, and a lower actuator or latch mechanism.

Labels printed in the figure:
- DOOR
- HINGE
- ROD
- LATCH
- FAIRING

No values, units, part numbers, or notes are printed in the figure.
